\caption{Every pre-registered decision rule (node.yaml, written before the runs), applied mechanically (analysis/evidence.py). PASS/FAIL: the rule's condition holds / fails and cannot change with the pending jobs; *: provisional (decided on the finished jobs, but further seeds of counted systems are still running and can move the CIs); INCONCL.: pending systems decide; PENDING: no data; REPORT.: descriptive rule (reported, no pass/fail). Outcomes are the headline reading: single method (author decision 2026-10-26: HyperKKL $:=$ lora, $r=4$, no best-of-variants selection) on 5 dev plants (post-hoc exclusion, author decision 2026-10-26: duffing excluded as non-discriminating, decided after seeing results; thresholds $k/6$ scaled to $\lceil 5k/6\rceil/5$, e.g.\ $\geq$4/6 $\to$ $\geq$4/5). Where this differs from the as-pre-registered reading (best of variants, 6 dev plants), that outcome is shown below it (pre-reg.; k/6 = single method on 6 plants; `(same)' = unchanged). Vote counts k/n are not corrected for multiplicity (6 systems, several tiers and nodes).}\label{tab:decisions}\\
